blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward
to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual
tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction.
A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization
to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually
need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives
token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is
that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both
signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its
video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We
instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived
question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached,
question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition
log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On
VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the
base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three
SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68–3.15 points and across four reward
models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33–3.15 points.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-video generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Lightricks, 2025 ) has advanced rapidly with diffusion ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) and flow-matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) models.
As base models improve, post-training that aligns generated videos with prompts, human preferences, and evaluation criteria has become increasingly important ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2024 ) .
Inspired by reinforcement learning for language models ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) , recent work adapts Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to video generation ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) by converting the deterministic denoising ODE into an SDE sampler, which defines a stochastic policy over latent denoising trajectories.
For each prompt, GRPO samples a group of videos, scores each completed trajectory, and updates the generator with group-relative advantages, with no separate value model.
blocks.zh:
文本到视频生成(Wan等,2025;Kong等,2024;Wu等,2025a;Polyak等,2024;Lightricks,2025)随着传播(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015;Ho等,2020;Rombach等,2022;Ho等,2022)和流量匹配(Lipman等,2023)模型得到迅速发展.
随着基础模型的完善,将生成的视频与提示,人取向,评价标准相配合的后期培训变得越来越重要(徐等,2023;刘等,2025b;徐等,2024.
受语言模型强化学习的启发(欧阳等,2022;肖等,2024;DeepSeek-AI,2025),近期工作适应. 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等,2024年)到视频生成(Liu等,2025a; 薛等,2025;郑等,2026),通过将定型去诺化ODE转换为SDE采样器,定义了比潜在去诺化轨迹的分化政策.
对于每个快取,GRPO对一组视频进行取样,对每组完成的轨迹进行分分,并用组相相关的优点更新生成器,没有单独的值模型.

blocks.en:
Despite this progress, video RL faces a fundamental credit-assignment bottleneck.
Training must determine not only whether one trajectory is better than another, but also when and where the reward-relevant evidence appears.
A video-level scalar reward can rank completed denoising trajectories, but it cannot indicate which video tokens are responsible for success or failure ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) ( Figure 2 ).
This limitation matters because the evidence for many prompt requirements is confined to a small region or a few frames, for example, whether the requested grand piano is rendered as a piano rather than a generic keyboard ( Figure 1 ), whether a watch case is rose gold, whether the described fireflies appear in the scene at all, or whether the camera pans to the right instead of staying static.
Broadcasting the same scalar advantage to every latent token therefore spends update capacity on regions that have nothing to do with the evaluated error.
Recent work separates the video-level reward from token credit ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , but derives credits from perceptual features independent of rewards.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,视频RL仍面临一个基本的信用分配瓶颈.
培训不仅必须确定一种轨迹是否优于另一种轨迹,还必须确定与奖励有关的证据何时何地出现。
视频级分级奖励可以对已完成的去名道出轨迹进行分级,但不能说明是哪个视频标志对成败负责(Wu等,2025b;Wang等,2026;梁等,2026)(图2).
这种限制很重要,因为许多即时要求的证据仅限于一个小区域或几个帧,例如,所请求的大钢琴是作为钢琴而不是通用键盘提供(图1),手表箱是玫瑰金色的,被描述的萤火虫在现场完全出现,或者相机锅是右侧而不是静止.
因此,广播对每个潜在标志具有同样的分级优势,因此,将更新能力花在那些与评估错误无关的区域。
近期的作品将视频层面的奖励与象征性的信用区分开来(Ni等,2026年),但获得的信用来自独立于奖励的认知特征.

blocks.en:
The missing quantity is a routing signal tied to the reward itself.
Score gradients provide such a signal because they measure how sensitive an evaluator’s score is to local changes in the video-frame input ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ) .
Prior differentiable reward methods typically use these gradients to update the generator directly.
In GRPO, we use them differently: after detachment, their magnitudes weight denoising log-probabilities, while the group-relative advantage remains the scalar RL signal.
This preserves the clipped policy-gradient structure of GRPO and avoids backpropagating the reward loss through the generator.
The remaining requirement is semantic alignment: the score being differentiated must represent the requirement whose credit we want to localize.
blocks.zh:
缺失的数量是连接在奖励本身上的通路信号.
得分梯度提供了这样的信号,因为它们衡量评价员的得分对视频帧输入的当地变化有多敏感(徐等,2023;克拉克等,2023;普拉布德赛等,2023;普拉布德赛等,2024).
以前不同的奖励方法一般使用这些梯度直接更新生成器.
在GRPO中,我们使用它们的方式不同:分解后,它们的分量能减轻日志概率,而群相相的优势仍然是平分RL信号.
这保留了GRPO被剪切的政策级结构,并避免了通过生成器回溯奖励损失.
剩下的要求是语义上的对等:分数有区别必须代表我们希望将其信用本地化的要求.

blocks.en:
This score–credit alignment makes the choice of evaluator interface central.
Custom video reward models provide differentiable scalar feedback, but a single scalar head does not expose which semantic requirement its gradient should explain ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
We therefore use an evaluator whose score is tied to an explicit video-grounded question, so the reward and the sensitivity map are computed from the same semantic check.
Pretrained VLMs ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) offer exactly such an interface: prompt following, physical plausibility, object interaction, and temporal consistency can all be phrased as video-grounded questions, and the teacher-forced likelihood of a reference answer measures whether each check is satisfied.
Because every question–answer likelihood is differentiable with respect to the VLM’s video-frame input, a single check provides both a scalar contribution to the rollout objective and a question-conditioned sensitivity map for routing its update.
Using a frozen, off-the-shelf evaluator also removes the need for reward-model training and per-check preference labels ( Furuta et al., 2024 ) .
This is the central idea of our work: the same semantic check that determines whether a prompt requirement is satisfied also estimates where the resulting policy update should be applied.
blocks.zh:
此分数 - 信用对接使得选择评估界面成为中心.
自定义视频奖励模型提供不同的scalar回馈,但单个scalar头没有暴露哪个语义要求其梯度应该解释(Wang等,2026).
因此,我们使用一个评估员,他的得分与一个清晰的视频问题挂钩,所以奖励和敏感度地图是从同一个语义检查中计算出来的。
Pretrained VLMs (Quen Team, 2026; Bai等, 2025 ) 提供了这样的接口: 即时后继,物理上的合理性,对象相互作用,以及时间一致性都可以被说成是以视频为基础的问题,教师强制的参考解答措施的可能性是否满足了每次检查.
因为每个问题 - 答案的可能性在VLM的视频帧输入上是不同的,所以一次检查既提供了对推出目标的分级贡献,又提供了用于路径更新的有问题条件的敏感性地图.
使用被冻结的现成评价员也无需进行奖励模式培训和每一次检查的首选标签(Furuta等人,2024年)。
这是我们工作的核心思想:同样的语义检查,决定一项迅速要求是否得到满足,也估计在哪些地方应适用由此产生的政策更新。

blocks.en:
Building on this observation, we propose TVRL (Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning), a training framework in which a video policy is evaluated by video-level rewards but updated through explicit token-level credit; the name does not assume that video tokens are discrete actions. We instantiate the framework for text-to-video diffusion with a clipped group-relative objective.
For each prompt, we construct binary video-grounded checks and score generated videos by the teacher-forced VLM likelihood of the reference answers.
Each check yields two coupled quantities from the same scalar: a question reward given by the likelihood value, and a detached token-credit proxy given by the magnitude of its video-frame-input gradient. The latter measures local sensitivity rather than signed or causal credit.
We average the question rewards before group-relative normalization to obtain a single rollout-level advantage shared across checks, and we use each question-conditioned credit map to reweight the dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped GRPO surrogate.
The shared advantage sets the direction and strength of the update, while the credit maps determine its spatio-temporal allocation.
This design preserves group-relative rollout ranking and ratio clipping, and it never backpropagates reward gradients through the generator.
Averaging several checks also reduces reliance on any single question.
Our contributions are: • We derive token-level credit for video GRPO from the reward itself: a frozen VLM supplies both a question reward and a detached, question-conditioned sensitivity map, requiring neither task-specific reward-model training nor dense credit labels. • We develop a shared-advantage, localized-routing objective that aggregates question rewards into one rollout-level advantage and uses the credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities within the clipped GRPO ratio. Under the baseline’s log-probability reduction, uniform weights recover scalar-reward GRPO. • With the SAGE sampler, TVRL improves VBench-2.0 Overall over the corresponding GRPO baselines by +1.36, +1.33, +1.85, and +3.15 points with VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B rewards, respectively. With the Qwen3.5-9B reward fixed, it also improves over GRPO under the SAGE, Flow, and Dance samplers by +3.15, +2.92, and +2.68 points. Ablations cover credit granularity and the choice of VLM critic.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,我们提议TVRL(Token-Level Video加强学习),这是一个培训框架,通过视频层面的奖励来评价视频政策,但通过明确的象征性信用加以更新;名称并不假定视频标识是独立的行动。 我们以剪接的集团相对目标,即时地制定文本到视频传播的框架。
对于每个提示,我们构建二进制的视频定位检查 和分数生成的视频 通过教师强制VLM的可能性 参考答案。
每次检查都产生两个相加的数量:一个是按概率值给出的问题奖励,另一个是按视频-帧-输入梯度的大小给出的离子信用代用。 后者衡量当地敏感性,而不是签字或因果信用。
我们平均在分组相对正常化前给予问题奖励,以获得单一的推出级优势,这些优势贯穿于所有检查中,我们利用每个问题有条件的信用地图来重新权衡被剪接的GRPO代理中密集的去诺-过渡日志概率.
共享优势设定了更新的方向和强度,而信用地图则决定了它的平时分配.
这种设计保留了群体相适应的推出排名和比例剪接方式,它从不通过生成器反向传播奖励梯度.
提出几项检查也减少了对任何单一问题的依赖。
• 我们的贡献是: 我们从奖励本身获得视频GRPO的象征性信用:被冻结的VLM既提供问题奖励,又提供解开的、附有问题条件的敏感性地图,既不需要针对特定任务的奖励模式培训,也不需要密集的信用标签。 我们开发了一个共享优势,本地化的路线目标,将奖励问题汇总到一个推出层面的优势中,并利用信用地图在被剪接的GRPO比例内重新加权密集去诺-过渡日志概率. 在基准的对数概率还原下,统一重量可回收分级奖励GPRO。 • 通过SAGE取样器,TVRL将V Bench-2.0总体改进于相应的GRPO基线,分别为+1.36、+1.33、+1.85和+3.15分,并附有VideoAlign、VideoScore2、United Reward2和Quen3.5-9B奖励。 随着Qwen3.5-9B奖励的固定,它也比SAGE,Flow,和舞蹈采样器下的GRPO提高了+3.15分,+2.92分和+2.68分. 分红覆盖了信用颗粒性和VLM评论员的选择.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Alignment of video generators has increasingly moved beyond a single global score toward feedback structured by space, time, or evaluation criterion.
Differentiable reward optimization obtains such feedback by backpropagating reward gradients through the decoder and the denoising chain ( Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
These gradients encode how sensitive the score is to local video evidence, but using them to update the generator directly requires keeping the reward model, the decoder, and the multi-step denoising graph in memory, and repeated Jacobian products along the stochastic chain can amplify unstable local gradients.
Other dense-feedback methods expose localized failures through temporal preference labels, dense captions, rich human or AI feedback, or patch-level reward models ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Krishna et al., 2017 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , at the cost of additional annotation or a separately trained localized reward model.
Structured alignment systems ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and ViPO ( Ni et al., 2026 ) redistribute a scalar evaluation or GRPO advantage to finer units, yet their allocation maps come from perceptual priors rather than from the check that produced the reward.
Recent VLM-based video evaluators instead express prompt requirements as semantic questions rather than task-specific reward heads ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) .
TVRL uses this interface to couple reward evaluation with token-level credit: teacher-forced answer likelihoods score prompt-level checks, and detached video-frame-input gradients weight the denoising log-probabilities within GRPO.
Unlike Diffusion-DRF ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which also uses structured VLM feedback but backpropagates it through the generator, the VLM gradient here stops at the credit map; unlike scalar GRPO, it changes where the update is applied; and unlike dense-feedback methods, it needs no dense labels or localized reward model.
blocks.zh:
视频生成器的对接已日益超越单一的全球得分,转向按空间、时间或评价标准排列的反馈。
可区别的奖励优化通过解码器和去诺化链回传奖励梯度获得这种反馈(Clark等,2023;Prabhudesai等,2023;Prabhudesai等,2024;Yuan等,2024;Wang等,2026).
这些梯度编码了分数对本地视频证据的敏感性,但利用它们来更新生成器直接需要将奖励模型,解码器,多步去诺图保存在内存中,而沿斯多克链重复的雅各布产品可以放大不稳定的本地梯度.
其他密集回馈方法通过时间偏好标签,密集标题,丰富的人文或AI反馈,或补丁级奖励模型暴露出本地化失败(Wu等,2025b;Krishna等,2017;Xiong等,2024;Liang等,2024;Liu等,2025b;Wang等,2025a),以额外的注解或单独训练的本地化奖励模型为代价.
结构化的对接系统(梁等,2026年)和VIPO(Ni等,2026年)向更精细的单位重新分配了分级评价或GRPO的优势,然而其分配图却出自能感知的先行图而不是产生奖励的检查.
近期基于VLM的视频评价员以语义问题而不是针对特定任务的奖励主管来表达即时要求(Quen Team,2026;He等,2025;Wang等,2025b.).
TVRL使用这个接口来进行夫妇奖励评价并获得象征性的信用:教师强制的回答概率得分即时的检查,以及脱开的视频-帧-输入梯度在GRPO内对去诺的日志-概率进行加权.
不同于传播-DRF (Wang等,2026),也使用结构化的VLM回馈但通过生成器进行回馈,这里的VLM梯度会停留在信用地图上;与scalar GRPO不同,它会改变应用更新的地方;与密集反馈方法不同,它不需要密集的标签或本地化的奖励模式.

blocks.en:
GRPO removes the need for a learned value model by sampling multiple outputs for the same prompt and normalizing their rewards within the group, which makes it attractive for large video generators ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
Recent video GRPO methods adapt this formulation to diffusion and flow models by treating denoising as a stochastic policy and defining transition log-probabilities along sampled latent trajectories.
Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , DanceGRPO ( Xue et al., 2025 ) , and SAGE-GRPO ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) instantiate this framework with different stochastic denoising samplers.
All of them optimize a clipped policy-gradient objective, but with a scalar reward they assign one terminal reward to each rollout and apply the resulting group-relative advantage uniformly across denoising steps and latent video tokens.
Such a reward indicates whether a video is better than the others in its prompt group, not where the update should concentrate.
Our video instantiation of TVRL is complementary to these samplers: it retains the clipped group-relative update and replaces uniform assignment with VLM-gradient token credit that reweights the dense denoising log-probabilities before the policy ratio is formed.
blocks.zh:
GRPO通过对多个产出进行抽样,使其在组内获得同样迅速的回报并正常化,从而消除了学习价值模型的必要性,这使其对大型视频生成器具有吸引力(Shao等,2024年).
近期的视频GRPO方法通过将去诺化作为一种有条理的政策,并沿所取样的潜在轨迹界定过渡日志概率来使这种配方适应传播和流出模式.
Flow-GRPO(刘等,2025年a),舞蹈GRPO (薛等,2025年),和SAGE-GRPO(郑等,2026年)用不同的去诺分样器将这个框架即时化.

blocks.en: Across the tested configurations, TVRL improves over matched GRPO baselines with several stochastic samplers and differentiable evaluators. It raises VBench-2.0 Overall with the SAGE, Flow, and Dance samplers and yields positive gains for all four evaluators tested under SAGE. These results establish empirical compatibility in the evaluated settings; they do not imply sampler- or evaluator-independent guarantees.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized in video reinforcement learning, and instantiated it in GRPO for text-to-video diffusion. Averaged teacher-forced question rewards set the sign and strength of each update through a shared group-relative advantage, and detached VLM gradients set its spatio-temporal allocation inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL improves over matched GRPO baselines for all four reward models under SAGE (+1.33 to +3.15 Overall) and for all three samplers with Qwen3.5-9B (+2.68 to +3.15), and × 3 3\!\times\!3 spatial credit outperforms both coarser and unsmoothed × 1 1\!\times\!1 credit. TVRL shows a promising direction for video RL: moving from trajectory-level to token-level updates, so that each rollout’s advantage acts on the video tokens that determine its reward. We expect token-level credit to extend to longer videos and other evaluators.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了TVRL, 这个框架从视频强化学习中优化的奖励中获得象征性的信用, 平均教师强制提问奖励通过共享的群相关系优势,确定每次更新的标志和强度,并分解的VLM梯度在被剪切的政策比内设定其斯皮提-时相分配. blocks.en: The observed mean increases from 666.05 to 786.04 seconds per update, a difference of 119.99 seconds (18.02%). This is an implementation-level wall-clock comparison, not an isolated measurement of VLM backward cost. In particular, the credit implementation also recomputes old-policy log-probabilities for weighted routing; this required work is included in the reported elapsed time. The comparison uses existing runs rather than a controlled timing rerun: the baseline and credit runs use VideoAlign MQ/TA/VQ reward weights of ( 0.5 , 1 , 0.5 ) (0.5,1,0.5) and ( 1 , 1 , 1 ) (1,1,1) , respectively, and different prompt-file variants (original versus question-decomposed). The baseline reward-frame count is inherited from its reward-model defaults, while the credit run explicitly uses six frames; identical historical frame sampling, source revisions, and execution conditions have not been verified. We therefore report 18.02% as the observed overhead for this pair, rather than a universal overhead estimate or evidence of a wall-clock speedup.

blocks.en: We fix 12 disjoint pairs of source prompts and two generation seeds per pair, yielding 24 video pairs. Each source contributes 20 uniformly sampled frames, center-cropped to a square and resized to fill an equal-size panel; the crop is fixed and not object-aware. An earlier construction instead letterboxed each full frame into its panel with neutral padding, which left the content in roughly half of the panel area; we report it as a second row on the same pairs and questions. For each pair, we concatenate the panels as A ​ B AB and B ​ A BA and ask separately whether target A A or target B B is present. The questions do not specify positions. Unlike the full training question set, this diagnostic uses object-presence checks. Before computing gradients, we review three frames per pair and require each target to be visible in at least two. This qualifies 20 crop-to-fill pairs: one pair contains an ambiguous piano-like object, and in three pairs the fixed crop removes the target from at least two reviewed frames. The letterbox construction qualifies 23 pairs under the same rule. Unqualified pairs are retained in the all-pairs analysis, every prompt-pair group keeps at least one qualified pair, and no pairs are replaced after observing gradients. The construction uses known panel boundaries rather than detector or segmenter masks; each panel nevertheless contains background as well as the target.

The reward for a slot is the mean target-answer log-probability over the answer-value tokens in the reference answer. Slot rewards are averaged into the rollout reward before group-relative normalization. Credit weights come from the absolute gradient of each slot reward with respect to the processed VLM video-frame input, normalized across time and space for spatial routing (across time for frame-only routing). The maps remain question-conditioned but share one rollout-level advantage. All slots are evaluated in one teacher-forced sequence; later slots are conditioned on preceding reference tokens, not statistically independent answers. Answer-token predictions from that same forward pass are used only for monitoring: they neither select the fixed reference target nor enter the main reward. Autoregressive free-generation scoring is a separate ablation.

blocks.en: This analysis is conditional: it does not establish that a VLM gradient is a perfect causal explanation of video semantics. The gradient is a local, model-dependent sensitivity measure, and its absolute value captures importance rather than sign. The practical claim is that when this sensitivity aligns with prompt-relevant temporal evidence, token credit concentrates the GRPO update on the frames where changes most likely affect the reward.
blocks.zh: 这种分析是有条件的:它没有确定VLM梯度是视频语义的完美因果解释. 梯度是一个局部的,模型依赖的敏感性度量,其绝对值捕捉出重要性而不是签名. 实际的说法是,当这种敏感性与及时相关的时间证据相一致时,象征性信用将集中用于GPRO更新最可能影响奖励的框架。

blocks.en: The raw VLM-gradient map is a local sensitivity estimate rather than a noise-free causal attribution. Without spatial aggregation, isolated high-frequency responses can survive normalization and assign disproportionate credit to a few latent cells. This lowers the effective number of credited units and can increase update variance, as described by Equation B11 . PPO clipping limits excessive likelihood-ratio contributions but cannot correct a persistently mislocalized routing direction. The more severe VideoScore2 failure suggests that robustness at cell-level resolution also depends on the structure of the evaluator’s reward sensitivity; it implies neither that question-level advantages are required nor that token credit is ineffective.
blocks.zh: 原始的VLM梯度图是局部敏感度估计,而不是无噪声的因果归属. 没有空间聚合,孤立的高频反应就可以在正常化后存活下来并给少数潜在细胞分配了不成比例的功分. 如Equation B11所描述的,这降低了信用单位的有效数量并会增加更新差异. PPO剪接会限制过高的可能性-比例贡献,但无法纠正持续错误的路由方向. 更严重的VideoScore2失败表明,细胞一级分辨率的稳健性也取决于评价者奖励敏感性的结构;这意味着既不需要问题一级的好处,也不意味着象征性的信用无效。
